responsibility: Implements loop header copying in tree SSA. The pass decides when a loop header is small and profitable enough to duplicate, classifies header statements by invariance and induction-variable dependence, duplicates one or more entry tests into the preheader so the loop body becomes more do-while-like, updates SSA and loop structure afterwards, and then runs region RPO value numbering over the copied header paths to simplify duplicated exit tests for later vectorization and loop optimizations.
